cohort: Continue all 12 pre-existing sessions 5-6 and 7-8 four-path windows in six training conversations. The first eight windows were inspected before this diagnostic was specified. Use all originally eligible questions and both action backgrounds at each position. Publish counts, unique questions and per-dialogue results. No formal validation or test data enter the diagnostic.
contrast: Compare activity to temporal in the third slot at each position. Record every non-tie, strict full-reference recovery in either direction and evidence linkage to the actual manipulated span. At the root these are schedule contrasts: the suffix is rebuilt after changing the root. Only probe terminal contrasts for signed selection evidence, with the entire prefix, writer input and other two slots fixed.
probes: For each linked strict terminal candidate, check archived executor requests, independently reapply both sets of measured actions in their native batches, then reproduce both ordered retrievals, predictions, token counts and F1 with the deployed reader. Retain every original weak-bank write. Append the missing dated source quotes for this question's annotated turns in the terminal span and run native top-5 retrieval. Separately replace the last read slot with one hidden original memory chosen by question and evidence-turn overlap, without using the answer. Read both interventions with the same greedy model. Possible full-reference recovery under either intervention vetoes extra selection credit. An invalid control, action fault or identical reader context also contributes zero. Collect original IDs, type, costs, contexts and results before aggregating. Assigned paths are supervised contrasts only.
interpretation: Report directions separately for the two actual prefixes and count the same question once when assessing agreement. A question recovered under two prefixes supplies two correlated contrasts. The number of surviving training observations does not establish out-of-dialogue F1 gain.
